chapter: First bands and the road in the South
title: The carnival summer with Lester Young's family band
summary: At about ten to twelve he heard Lester Young at a carnival, and his father let him join the Young family band; his brother went along.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Yeah. Cootie, before I -- it's a shame to interrupt you, but before we get too far away from it, I want you to recall back, when you went to that carnival, because that's very interesting. You worked that summer with Lester and Lee and their father.
I imagine I was around ten or twelve years old.
And your father took you to the carnival?
Any of the others of you, or just you?
Me and maybe my other brother.
I can't recall. Just me because I
Well, that's why he took you.
Yeah. So I heard Lester playing.
And I said, 'Dad, I sure do want to play with them.' And he was talking, and so on the way back home, he says, -- wait a minute, now -- the next day, I think, I went around and played with them.
Yeah. I had my horn and went around and played with them.
What did you do? I mean, tell me about it. What was it like? Were they -- was it a tent?
And you went around in the daytime?
I went around in the daytime. He talked to Lester's father. He had the band.
Yeah. He was a trumpet player, wasn't he?
All of them were saxophone players. There was Lester, Lee and ISMA Heerman.
Not during that time. He played
So they had an act on the stage.
Playing saxophones. And my father talked with him. He wanted me, after he heard me play.
Yeah. So my father said, 'Well, I can't let him go away from home by himself, because he's too young. You'll have to take his older brother.' The one older to me, next to me.
So he said, 'Yeah, I'll take him.'
What did he have him do?
Nothing. He didn't do nothing. He worked on the carnival, doing different things.
And that's how I went on the show with Lester.
